task_assessment.objective: Finish the broad request after both families are assessed but causal attribution is insufficient.

claims.statement: Clipping is not supported because clipping_mechanism is false despite substantial clipping ratio and flat-top rule FAILs. Harmonic distortion is not supported because series_kind is native_odd_series without reportable even-order presence, and THD rule FAIL alone does not establish causal harmonic distortion.

limitations: Clipping_mechanism is false, so substantial clipping ratio and flat-top rule FAILs do not establish causal clipping.
Harmonic series is native_odd_series with no reportable even-order presence; THD rule FAIL establishes elevated harmonic content but not causal harmonic_distortion.
